title: Louvre Pyramid
blurb: I. M. Pei’s 1989 glass pyramid in the Cour Napoleon: 21.6 m high on a 34 m square base, 673 panes of extra-clear Diamond Glass on a steel frame, with three smaller pyramids and reflecting pools.

sourceUrls.label: The Better Vacation: Louvre Pyramid guide

systems.name: Glass skin
systems.description: The 673 glass segments of extra-clear laminated Diamond Glass: 603 rhombus and 70 triangular panes.

systems.name: Steel frame
systems.description: The 95 tonnes of steel and 105 tonnes of aluminium carrying the glass: edge beams, ring beams and mullions.

systems.name: Base curb
systems.description: The curb the pyramid sits on in the Cour Napoleon.

systems.name: Small pyramids
systems.description: The three smaller pyramids serving the Richelieu, Sully and Denon wings.

systems.name: Reflecting pools
systems.description: The reflecting pools flanking the pyramid (schematic).

systems.name: Courtyard paving
systems.description: The paving of the Cour Napoleon (schematic).

systems.name: Underground lobby
systems.description: Access housings for the underground lobby visitors descend into (schematic).
